svg.text: Cut five 3,800 mm lengths of 50 x 150 mm; treat the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each lies on edge across both beams along the store, at the marks

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 700 mm apart, ends 12 mm past the beams' outer faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fix each crossing with a galvanized hurricane tie rated 2 kN or

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: more, nailed with the tie maker's nails (the wind lifts about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1.1 kN at each crossing, ZBX-CAL-001 section 10).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 100 mm deep purlin is not strong enough for this span.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: tops in one plane within 5 mm (string line across).
